name: io.github.zhaoxinghua09-cell/medxpert-ortho-mcp
title: MedXpert 骨科器械检测对接（8 工具）
description: Orthopedic device testing MCP: lab match, quotes, UDI, standards, timelines, gap reports. Offline.

environmentVariables.name: ORTHO_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory of your own JSON datasets (labs/quotes/udi/standards/judgment_trees/timelines). Omit to use the bundled sample data.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.tools: match_labs, calc_quote, check_udi, query_standard, find_judgment_tree, get_region_path, check_timeline, report_gap
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.data_note: All bundled datasets are illustrative samples, not an accreditation directory, a price commitment or a regulatory conclusion. Every tool result carries sample_data: true until ORTHO_DATA_DIR points at your own data.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.provenance: Built 2026-11-16 to satisfy a dependency that four MedXpert expert packs had referenced since 2026 while it did not exist.
